title: Velocity 2010:  James Hamilton, "Datacenter Infrastructure Innovation"
summary: James Hamilton of AWS gives a Velocity 2010 keynote on datacenter infrastructure innovation, focused on power and cooling costs and a breakdown of where datacenter spending goes.
why: HN points to it for Hamilton's datacenter cost breakdown and as a primary source for claims about power versus hardware costs.

quote.text: You should check out his Velocity talk for more (about 5 minutes in)
